scope: Fit634/calibration159 only; no official-test content, model execution, fitting, or frozen-file modifications

lookback.mean_vs_sum: Mean/mean agrees with official equation and pinned step01_extract_attns.py. Sum/sum would be a different length-dependent feature.
lookback.qa_query: Post-read actual response-token position i. Causal mask allows keys <= i, including diagonal/self-attention.
lookback.official_query: Generation step predicts y_t from the last prefix/prior-answer position; y_t not appended until after attentions are stored.
lookback.qa_context_pool: Only tokens overlapping exact released retrieved_passages block. Question, instructions, BOS/chat wrapper excluded from both ratio pools.
lookback.official_nq_context_pool: Whole input prefix through document/question/task instruction, excluding fixed #Answer#: suffix; that suffix is in the new-token pool along with prior generated tokens.
lookback.qa_answer_pool: All actual response tokens from the first through current token, including diagonal; denominator uses this causal count, not full eventual answer length.
lookback.boundary_policy: Token overlap, not strict character containment; boundary tokens may include neighboring separator characters.
lookback.unselected_input_tokens: Still visible to model and included in full causal attention softmax; excluded from ratio pools. Shared softmax normalization cancels algebraically in ratio; input content still affects q/k.
lookback.precision: NF4 BF16 q/k matmul and float32 softmax/reduction. Official generation used unquantized FP16 settings; historic trace is not available.
lookback.claim_limit: A source-only post-read Lookback adaptation, not exact reproduction of original experimental features. No evidence yet that these differences explain development performance.

timing.hidden_last: post-read i, final model RMSNorm output
timing.nll: pre-read i-1 predicts actual token i
timing.future: Causal masking excludes future content. Full teacher-forced reconstruction is not asserted numerically identical to every variable-length online prefix run.

proof_revalidation.gpu_oracle_scope: Existing two development answers; LB sampled query rows, NLL first16; float32-softmax LB/NLL/hidden differences zero, whole-repeat differences zero. All793 were hash/coordinate audited, not independently recomputed with another model implementation.

metric_adaptations: Four raw BPE tokens stride1 versus original Lookback experimental eight-token windows.
Risk=1 and all four official span types retained; original Lookback code factual=1 is an orientation convention, not a mismatch when labels/scores are consistently trained.
All quality-good unlabeled refusals are evaluated as negative, unlike R16 refusal localization exclusion.
Calibration F1 is selection-optimistic; paper AUROC is not an F1 benchmark; original test remains sealed.
